title: azdw Allowed Tools Configuration
description: Defines which CLI tools the AI is permitted to execute during chat sessions.

name.description: Unique alias for the tool (e.g., 'dot'). Alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores only.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the tool executable (e.g., '/usr/local/bin/dot').

description.description: Human-readable description of the tool's purpose.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum execution time in seconds before the process is killed.
